what: S8 T-0138 (Haiku, escalated) produced a 16.7 KB monolithic page.tsx with inline actions that ignored the reviewed S8 components; swarm go then refused T-0168 (output-cap-exceeded, 15 KB per-file cap) before running, so no escalation happened. A ticket with a named test file under a verify profile never reaches Codex (routingFor skipped), and editing risk in the ledger breaks the approval seal
rule: Keep page files under 12 KB: tell workers to compose existing components and put server actions in their own file; an output-cap refusal before dispatch should escalate the ticket to Codex instead of aborting go.
fix: Moved the four inline server actions and helpers into actions.ts and request-data.ts by hand (pure move) so T-0168 to T-0171 can run on Haiku
